name: PAIR_RELATIVE_VALUE_LOG_RATIO_RESEARCH

closed_or_failed: metal compression-break exact candidate not forward-eligible under frozen DD gate
stage0003 single-asset structural families: 0 robust leads
stage0004 cross-sectional relative-strength families: 0 robust leads

rationale: Test a structurally distinct market-neutral-ish relative-value family using predeclared economically related pairs, not performance-selected pairs.

signal.zscore: current spread versus mean/std of PREVIOUS lookback synchronized completed pair bars; current bar excluded from reference window
signal.entry_condition: abs(z)>=threshold AND previous abs(z)<threshold (one threshold-crossing event)
signal.mean_reversion: z>0 => short A / long B; z<0 => long A / short B
signal.exit: fixed hold_pair_bars later on synchronized pair-bar opens
signal.overlap: same pair cannot open a new event until prior fixed-horizon event has exited
signal.cost: equal-notional two-leg observed entry spreads; 0.5 weight each leg
signal.pnl: equal-notional 0.5/0.5 leg percentage return, converted to basis points

robustness_gates.positive_pair_ratio: ALL >=0.625; FX >=0.60; diagnostic scope not lead-eligible
robustness_gates.both_z_sides_positive: events initiated by z>0 and z<0 each mean >0

neighbor_definition: same scope/style; exactly one of lookback/z_entry/hold moves to adjacent predefined grid value; neighbor good if mean>0, stress2>0, trim1>0
next_if_robust_lead: freeze best predeclared pair rule; execution/reproduction validation only on exposed history
next_if_no_lead: continue to another structurally distinct family; do not micro-tune failed grid
